verdict.line: You lose if you let Gwen poke freely levels 1-5 and extend trades into her Q center; you win once Kaenic Rookern is online and you can punish her Hallowed Mist cooldown.

brief.thesis: Gwen's entire kit is magic damage and her passive, A Thousand Cuts, scales bonus damage off your health — so the tankier you build, the harder her autos and Q center hit. The matchup swings on whether you fight her while her W (Hallowed Mist) is up (she can only be targeted inside the mist, effectively unkillable) or catch her with it down, where she has no defensive tool left.

theirWindow.when: her E and Q are both up
theirWindow.what: She dashes in with E (Skip 'n Slash) to get the attack-speed/range buff, then unloads Q (Snip Snip!) stacks on you — if you're caught without your own Q stacks or E (Footwork) shield ready, back off rather than trading face-first.

yourWindow.when: her Hallowed Mist is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Without W up she has zero escape beyond her short E dash — commit your W (Path Maker) charge-dash stun or, at level 6+, R (All Out) to knock her through terrain and go all-in before she can reset the fight.

runes.keystoneWhy: both measured rune pages run it — the proc heal and HP growth offset her poke-heavy early game while you wait for item power.

summoners.why: the clear preferred pick in measured games (58.3% WR, 80% pick) — Teleport lets you play the lane patiently for the Rookern power spike instead of forcing all-ins you can't yet win.

playing.title: Bank Q stacks before engaging
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes (Q, 3.5s cooldown) needs two hits to fire the pulling shockwave. Land the first hit on a safe poke, then commit the all-in on the second so the pull — not a random strike — starts the fight.

playing.title: Fight when Hallowed Mist is down
playing.detail: Track her W cooldown (22-18s by rank). If it's down, she has no way to make herself untargetable — this is your window to commit W (Path Maker) or R (All Out).

playing.title: Punish her E dash in
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash (E) locks her into melee range to use her attack-speed window. The instant she dashes onto you without mist ready, hit her with Q and chase with E (Footwork) before she gets her refund window.

playing.title: Don't stand in the center of her Q
playing.detail: Snip Snip! only deals true damage and applies her passive to units in the center of the cone — angle your trades so you're clipped by the cone edge, not eating the center hit, up to six times.

playing.title: Use R to cut off her escape
playing.detail: All Out knocks her through any wall in its path before you transform and chase — use it near terrain so her short-range E can't buy her the distance she needs to reset.

playing.title: Rush Rookern over raw HP items
playing.detail: Her full kit (Q, E on-hit, R, passive) is magic damage — the magic shield from Kaenic Rookern outvalues any pure-health purchase at this stage.

playing.title: Watch your own health bar as a damage source
playing.detail: A Thousand Cuts scales bonus magic damage off your current health — stacking HP without matching resistances (Jak'Sho, Spirit Visage) makes her autos hit harder, not safer.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners and the win-rate/pick-rate figures above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the kits, not measured data.
